name: Mimic Train - Build Tool Addon
displayDescription:
DISCLAIMER: This tool is still heavily WORK IN PROGRESS. Some features may not work as expected, please report bugs in the communications server!

Allows you to make your own grouped builds into moving trains!

Features include:
- Modifying (rotating, scaling, moving) models on the train
- Scaling glider/coupler distances
- Modifiable sounds (horn, bell, engine)
- Toggleable part collisions

STEAM LOCOMOTIVE ROD ANIMATIONS ARE NOT INCLUDED YET. THEY WILL BE ADDED IN THE FUTURE!

====================================================================================================

INSTRUCTIONS: When the train is selected (click), hover over a grouped build and press 'E' to set the model. For sounds, copy the Sound ID from the Roblox Creator Page & set in the DCC Programmer.

name: Meshes & Decals - Build Tool Addon
displayDescription:
!! IF YOU ALREADY PURCHASED THIS GAMEPASS PREVIOUSLY, YOU DO NOT NEED TO PURCHASE IT AGAIN !!

[DISCLAIMER: This is for people who have knowledge in either Decals or Meshes/Textures in Roblox! Decals may be low quality due to a lack of functionality on Roblox's end. If you are caught misusing this feature, in-game moderation action will be taken!]

This game pass allows you to add decals and meshes with textures to parts in-game using Build Tool.

====================================================================================================

NOTE: You cannot use mesh URLs directly at the current moment, you must import them in Roblox Studio to get the content ids.

INSTRUCTIONS: For decals, copy the Decal ID from the Roblox Creator Page & paste into the text box. For meshes, go into Roblox Studio to get the mesh ID & texture, then paste into the text box.
